## 5. Does the simulation separate interventions the current method treats as equivalent?
Pairs: (a) BRD4i vs EP300i: both inhibit, both have a qualified positive CollecTRI edge onto TNF and IL6 seeds, both H_HARM in proposals_it21 Q5 (BRD4 43 families, EP300 2).
